title: 2.13 More Colors
unit_title: Unit 2: Places, Things, Numbers and Colors
unit_outcome: Name places and things with their articles, count them, and say their color and size.
goal: Name brown, pink, purple and gray, and use sehr: Der Hund ist sehr groß.
grammar_function: Das ist + color; der/die/das + noun + ist (sehr) + adjective.
speaking_outcome: Say more colors and how big things are.
